mintAuthority.summary: Commission role holders can mint native liabilities across seven EVM-compatible deployments and a Solana Token-2022 one-of-two mint multisig; EVM upgraders can replace issuance logic immediately. October 15 authority pins remain unchanged. The current issuer procedure and observable business-day supply-versus-reserve series establish issuer-operated periodic reconciliation, not an independently retrieved examination opinion. The unexpired prior attestation-only supervision assessment is retained after a current daily examiner report-index recheck; the signed report body remains retrieval-blocked. Backend signing independence and complete transfer execution reach remain unresolved. The historical issuer/provider key-control dispute is not bound to an affected mint authority; no FRNT exploit or loss is established.

The native Solana one-of-two multisig and separate multiplier-one scaled-UI authority were verified at the retained October 15 slot; the slot-453519819 observation stays historical. June 3 scaled-UI transfer was re-read at finalized slot 424090107, 2026-06-03T19:29:21Z: only scaledUiAmount setAuthority and ComputeBudget instructions, not mint/burn or mint-authority remediation. The September 14 issuer private-key allegation and provider display-authority explanation remain unbound to an exact affected native control; neither resolution nor incident absence is inferred. Public signing/incident rules, CISO/provider statements, August 2025 audit archive, issuer materials, ReKt, DefiLlama hacks and CCIP advisories retain the bounded unknown incident/operator findings. Process supplement reviewed 2026-10-20: the Commission's authoritative attestation page commits to business-day custodian SFTP balances covering cash, Treasury and repo assets, supported-chain supply queried by The Network Firm, independent valuation and a published supply-versus-reserve comparison. The observable October 20 06:00 MT dashboard comparison is 968051.85 FRNT versus USD968051.85 net reserves; its exact eight chain/token rows match the authored native deployment inventory, and the October 16, 17 and 20 dated series establishes recurrence. This supports issuer-operated periodic reconciliation under the D33 adjudicated cadence bar, not an independent financial opinion. That latest report date is within the stated business-day cadence without an added publication-lag allowance; there is no observed missed current report or published termination, suspension or superseding scope exclusion. The legitimate Download Report action still requires human verification, so the report body and opinion were not newly retrieved. The prior positive supervision assessment is retained under the fetch-failure ruling, not newly inferred from failed retrieval or non-assured dashboard metrics. This supersedes the retrieval-only withdrawal; dashboard metrics remain expressly non-assured and do not substitute for a signed examination opinion. No prudential regime, incident clearance, new execution closure or reserve composition update is asserted.
